goal:
Two stations in a simulated flow trial report their own water deliveries. How securely can we prioritize one channel for a maintenance visit, taking account of the shared observed time and each logger's calibration? Give a reproducible numerical comparison for each trial and state what could change the visit decision.

This is a continuing study with staged input. The first station export is supplied now. A second trial, a dispatch criterion from the PI, and the station custody check will arrive separately. Please choose your own investigations. Record an interim recommendation when any part arrives and keep the study open for outstanding inputs. Close with a final recommendation after the custody check, when the reporting packet is complete.

final_decision.rationale: Withhold a maintenance visit for both trials. The PI requires the lower bound on North minus South delivery to exceed 1,000 L within a single trial. The POND-6 bounds are {{metric:gxa_01m8f6nv8tnv5zff3b:difference_low_L}} to {{metric:gxa_01m8f6nv8tnv5zff3b:difference_high_L}}, so North leads but the range straddles the dispatch threshold. The POND-7 bounds are {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:difference_low_L}} to {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:difference_high_L}}, so North leads and even the upper bound falls short. The completed custody register matches the POND-7 export digest, maps North to rack-B and South to rack-A, and confirms the original POND-6 assignment. The paired analyses cover both full trial windows and the reporting packet is complete.

rendered.rationale: Withhold a maintenance visit for both trials. The PI requires the lower bound on North minus South delivery to exceed 1,000 L within a single trial. The POND-6 bounds are 960.00 L to 1440.00 L, so North leads but the range straddles the dispatch threshold. The POND-7 bounds are 240.00 L to 960.00 L, so North leads and even the upper bound falls short. The completed custody register matches the POND-7 export digest, maps North to rack-B and South to rack-A, and confirms the original POND-6 assignment. The paired analyses cover both full trial windows and the reporting packet is complete.

Subtract and add the accumulated allowance to obtain the lower and upper bounds. The custody register identifies the second export by its matching digest.
